'},hoodie:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'}},
    round:{classic:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'},hoodie:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'}},
    diamond:{classic:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'},hoodie:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'}},
    bean:{classic:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'},hoodie:{idle:'data:image/webp;base64,',speaking:'data:image/webp;base64,'}}
  });
  function validatedStyle(value){
    const shape=styles.shape.some(item=>item.id===value?.shape)?value.shape:'pebble';
    const color=styles.color.some(item=>item.id===value?.color)?value.color:'sage';
    const outfit=value?.outfit==='hoodie'?'hoodie':'classic';
    return {shape,color,outfit,accessory:shape==='pebble'||outfit==='hoodie'?'glasses':'monocle'};
  }
  let appearance=(()=>{try{return validatedStyle(JSON.parse(globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(STYLE_KEY)||'null'));}catch{return validatedStyle(null);}})();
  let editorDraft=null,editorTab='shape';
  const appearanceLabel=(value=appearance)=>(value.shape==='pebble'?['shape','color']:['shape','color','outfit']).map(part=>styles[part].find(item=>item.id===value[part]).label).join(' · ');
  function applyAppearance(element,value){
    if(!element)return;
    element.setAttribute?.('data-shape',value.shape);element.setAttribute?.('data-color',value.color);element.setAttribute?.('data-outfit',value.outfit);
    element.setAttribute?.('aria-label','Milo毛绒面试官，'+appearanceLabel(value));
    element.querySelector?.('.ji-wool-character')?.setAttribute?.('aria-label','Milo毛绒面试官，'+appearanceLabel(value));
  }
  function syncAppearance(){
    const doc=globalThis.document,draft=editorDraft||appearance;
    applyAppearance(doc?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-stage'),appearance);
    applyAppearance(doc?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-editor-preview'),draft);
    doc?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-wool-frame]')?.forEach(img=>{
      const value=img.dataset.woolScope==='preview'?draft:appearance;
      const frame=img.dataset.woolFrame==='speaking'?'speaking':'idle';
      img.setAttribute('src',frames[value.shape][value.outfit][frame]);
    });
    doc?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-j-action="EXAMINER_STYLE"]')?.forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(draft[button.dataset.stylePart]===button.dataset.styleValue)));
    doc?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-editor-panel]')?.forEach(panel=>{panel.hidden=panel.dataset.editorPanel!==editorTab;});
    doc?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-j-action="EXAMINER_EDITOR_TAB"]')?.forEach(button=>{
      button.hidden=button.dataset.editorTab==='outfit'&&draft.shape==='pebble';
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(button.dataset.editorTab===editorTab));
    });
  }
  function persistAppearance(){try{globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(STYLE_KEY,JSON.stringify(appearance));}catch{/* This visit keeps its selection. */}}
  function closeEditor(){
    const dialog=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-editor');
    if(typeof dialog?.close==='function')dialog.close();else dialog?.removeAttribute?.('open');
    globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('[data-j-action="OPEN_EXAMINER_EDITOR"]')?.focus?.();
  }
  function handleAction(action,target){
    const dialog=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-editor');
    if(action==='OPEN_EXAMINER_EDITOR'){
      editorDraft={...appearance};editorTab='shape';syncAppearance();
      if(dialog&&!dialog.open){try{if(typeof dialog.showModal==='function')dialog.showModal();else dialog.setAttribute?.('open','');}catch{dialog.setAttribute?.('open','');}}
      return true;
    }
    if(action==='CLOSE_EXAMINER_EDITOR'){editorDraft=null;syncAppearance();closeEditor();return true;}
    if(action==='SAVE_EXAMINER_EDITOR'){if(editorDraft){appearance=validatedStyle(editorDraft);persistAppearance();}editorDraft=null;syncAppearance();closeEditor();return true;}
    if(action==='EXAMINER_EDITOR_TAB'){if(Object.hasOwn(styles,target?.dataset?.editorTab)&&!(target.dataset.editorTab==='outfit'&&(editorDraft||appearance).shape==='pebble')){editorTab=target.dataset.editorTab;syncAppearance();}return true;}
    if(action!=='EXAMINER_STYLE')return false;
    const part=target?.dataset?.stylePart,value=target?.dataset?.styleValue;
    if(!Object.hasOwn(styles,part)||!styles[part].some(item=>item.id===value))return true;
    const next=validatedStyle({...(editorDraft||appearance),[part]:value});
    if(editorDraft){editorDraft=next;if(next.shape==='pebble'&&editorTab==='outfit')editorTab='shape';}else{appearance=next;persistAppearance();}
    syncAppearance();return true;
  }
  function create({onChange}={}) {
    let generation=0, enabled=true, engaged=false, utterance=null, audio=null;
    let current={status:'ready',kind:'initial',text:'你好，我是Milo。准备好后，我们从一个问题开始。',label:'准备与你对话'};
    const nativeSupported=()=>typeof globalThis.SpeechSynthesisUtterance==='function'&&typeof globalThis.speechSynthesis?.speak==='function';
    const clipsFor=text=>{
      const bank=globalThis.CareerJourneyVoiceAssets;if(typeof bank?.resolve==='function')return bank.resolve(text);
      if(!bank?.normalize||!bank.clips)return [];
      const exact=bank.clips[bank.normalize(text)];if(exact)return [exact];
      const greeting='你好，我是面试官Milo。我们按你的节奏来。';
      if(text.startsWith(greeting)){
        const intro=bank.clips[bank.normalize(greeting)],question=bank.clips[bank.normalize(text.slice(greeting.length))];
        if(intro&&question)return [intro,question];
      }
      return [];
    };
    const supported=()=>typeof globalThis.Audio==='function'&&!!globalThis.CareerJourneyVoiceAssets||nativeSupported();
    function sync(){
      syncAppearance();
      const stage=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-stage');
      stage?.setAttribute?.('data-examiner-state',current.status);
      const caption=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-caption');
      const label=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-status');
      const panel=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('#j-examiner-caption-panel');
      if(panel)panel.hidden=panel.dataset?.compact!=='true'&&['initial','question'].includes(current.kind);
      if(caption)caption.textContent=current.text;
      if(label)label.textContent=panel?.dataset?.compact==='true'&&current.status==='ready'?'Milo · 面试官':current.label;
      const toggle=globalThis.document?.querySelector?.('[data-j-action="TOGGLE_EXAMINER_AUDIO"]');
      if(toggle){toggle.textContent=enabled?'考官声音：开':'考官声音：关';toggle.setAttribute?.('aria-pressed',String(enabled));}
      onChange?.({...current,enabled,engaged,supported:supported()});
    }
    function update(status,text,label,kind=current.kind){current={status,text:clean(text),label,kind};sync();}
    function stop(){
      generation++;
      if(audio){const previous=audio;audio=null;previous.onplaying=null;previous.onended=null;previous.onerror=null;previous.onpause=null;try{previous.pause();previous.removeAttribute?.('src');previous.load?.();}catch{/* Captions remain available. */}}
      if(utterance){try{globalThis.speechSynthesis?.cancel();}catch{/* Captions remain available. */}}utterance=null;
      update('ready',current.text,'等待你的回答');
    }
    function speak(text,{kind='response'}={}){
      const value=clean(text);if(!value)return;
      stop();engaged=true;current={...current,kind:kind==='question'?'question':'response'};
      if(!enabled){update('ready',value,'文字互动 · 声音已关闭');return;}
      if(!supported()){update('ready',value,'当前设备未提供语音，文字互动仍可使用');return;}
      const token=++generation;
      const clips=typeof globalThis.Audio==='function'?clipsFor(value):[];
      if(clips.length){
        update('preparing',value,'正在准备朗读');
        const failed=()=>{if(token!==generation)return;stop();update('ready',value,'声音暂未播放，可点击重播；也可以直接回答');};
        const playAt=(index,reuse=null)=>{
          if(token!==generation)return;
          try{
            const item=reuse||new globalThis.Audio(clips[index]);if(reuse)item.src=clips[index];audio=item;item.preload='auto';
            item.onplaying=()=>{if(token===generation)update('speaking',value,'Milo正在说话');};
            item.onpause=()=>{if(token===generation&&audio===item&&!item.ended)update('ready',value,'已暂停，点击听题可以重播');};
            item.onerror=failed;
            item.onended=()=>{
              if(token!==generation)return;
              item.onplaying=null;item.onended=null;item.onerror=null;item.onpause=null;audio=null;
              if(index+1<clips.length)playAt(index+1,item);
              else update('ready',value,'我说完了，接下来听你说');
            };
            const playback=item.play();playback?.catch?.(failed);
          }catch{failed();}
        };
        playAt(0);return;
      }
      if(!nativeSupported()){update('ready',value,'这段语音暂不可用，文字互动仍可继续');return;}
      try{
        const item=new globalThis.SpeechSynthesisUtterance(value);utterance=item;
        item.lang='zh-CN';item.rate=.96;item.pitch=1;
        const voices=globalThis.speechSynthesis.getVoices?.()||[];
        const voice=voices.find(v=>v.localService&&/^zh(?:-|_)/i.test(v.lang))||voices.find(v=>/^zh(?:-|_)/i.test(v.lang));
        if(voice)item.voice=voice;
        update('preparing',value,'正在准备朗读');
        item.onstart=()=>{if(token===generation)update('speaking',value,'Milo正在说话');};
        item.onend=()=>{if(token===generation){utterance=null;update('ready',value,'我说完了，接下来听你说');}};
        item.onerror=()=>{if(token===generation){utterance=null;update('ready',value,'声音暂未播放，可点击重播；也可以直接回答');}};
        globalThis.speechSynthesis.speak(item);
      }catch{utterance=null;update('ready',value,'声音暂不可用，文字互动仍可继续');}
    }
    function question(round,{greet=false}={}){speak((greet?'你好，我是面试官Milo。我们按你的节奏来。':'')+clean(round?.question),{kind:'question'});}
    function clarify(round){speak('我换个说法。这一题希望你讲清楚：'+clause(round?.feedback?.keep)+'。不用追求完美，可以选一件真实的小事，说明情境、你的动作和判断依据。没有做过的部分也可以直接说。');}
    function hint(round){speak('给你一个组织回答的起点：'+clause(round?.feedback?.nextTry)+'。先说你能确认的事实，再说你会怎样处理；把自己的贡献与团队的贡献分开。');}
    function acknowledge(answer,{final=false}={}){
      if(final){speak('六轮回答已经保存。我们一起核对复盘要点，接下来查看完整准备报告。');return;}
      speak(answer?.mode==='voice'?'这轮录音已经保存，可以在复盘里回听。我们一起看看表达要点，再继续下一个问题。':'这一轮回答已经保存。我们一起看看表达要点，接着我会继续提问。');
    }
    function listen(){stop();update('listening','我在听。请按自己的节奏说，结束后点击“结束录音”。','正在听你回答','response');}
    function toggle(){enabled=!enabled;stop();update('ready',current.text,enabled?'声音已打开，点击重播就能听到问题':'文字互动 · 声音已关闭');return enabled;}
    return Object.freeze({sync,stop,speak,question,clarify,hint,acknowledge,listen,toggle,supported,snapshot:()=>({...current,enabled,engaged})});
  }
  function character(h,value=appearance,scope='live'){
    const sources=frames[value.shape][value.outfit];
    return `<div class="ji-wool-character" role="img" aria-label="${h('Milo毛绒面试官，'+appearanceLabel(value))}"><img class="ji-wool-idle" data-wool-frame="idle" data-wool-scope="${scope}" src="${sources.idle}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" draggable="false"><img class="ji-wool-speaking" data-wool-frame="speaking" data-wool-scope="${scope}" src="${sources.speaking}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" draggable="false"></div>`;
  }
  function markup({h,btn,round,compact=false}){
    const pencil='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 4 5 5M4 20l4.8-1 11-11a2 2 0 0 0-4-4l-11 11L4 20Z" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
    const labels={shape:'形状',color:'颜色',outfit:'衣服与配饰'};
    const tabs=`<div class="ji-editor-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="装扮类别">${Object.keys(styles).map(part=>`<button type="button" role="tab" id="ji-tab-${part}" aria-controls="ji-panel-${part}" aria-selected="${editorTab===part}" data-j-action="EXAMINER_EDITOR_TAB" data-editor-tab="${part}"${part==='outfit'&&appearance.shape==='pebble'?' hidden':''}>${labels[part]}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
    const controls=Object.entries(styles).map(([part,items])=>`<fieldset id="ji-panel-${part}" class="ji-editor-group ji-editor-group--${part}" data-editor-panel="${part}" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="ji-tab-${part}"${editorTab===part?'':' hidden'}><legend class="sr-only">${labels[part]}</legend><div>${items.map(item=>`<button type="button" class="ji-look-option${part==='shape'?' ji-shape-option':''}" data-j-action="EXAMINER_STYLE" data-style-part="${part}" data-style-value="${item.id}" aria-pressed="${appearance[part]===item.id}">${part==='shape'?`<img src="${frames[item.id].classic.idle}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" draggable="false">`:part==='color'?`<span class="ji-color-swatch" data-swatch="${item.id}" aria-hidden="true"></span>`:''}<span>${h(item.label)}${item.detail?`<small>${h(item.detail)}</small>`:''}</span></button>`).join('')}</div></fieldset>`).join('');
    const editor=compact?'':`<dialog id="j-examiner-editor" class="ji-editor" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="ji-editor-title"><div class="ji-editor-head"><div><h2 id="ji-editor-title">装扮Milo</h2><p>选个喜欢的样子，保留一点个性，一起准备面试。</p></div><button type="button" class="ji-editor-close" data-j-action="CLOSE_EXAMINER_EDITOR" aria-label="关闭装扮窗口">×</button></div><div class="ji-editor-layout"><div id="j-examiner-editor-preview" class="ji-editor-preview" data-color="${appearance.color}" data-outfit="${appearance.outfit}" data-shape="${appearance.shape}">${character(h,appearance,'preview')}</div><div class="ji-editor-options">${tabs}${controls}</div></div><div class="ji-editor-actions"><button type="button" class="ji-editor-cancel" data-j-action="CLOSE_EXAMINER_EDITOR">取消</button><button type="button" class="ji-editor-save" data-j-action="SAVE_EXAMINER_EDITOR">保存装扮</button></div></dialog>`;
    return `<div id="j-examiner-stage" class="ji-stage${compact?' ji-stage--compact':''}" data-examiner-state="ready" data-shape="${appearance.shape}" data-color="${appearance.color}" data-outfit="${appearance.outfit}">${compact?'':`<button type="button" class="ji-edit-pencil" data-j-action="OPEN_EXAMINER_EDITOR" title="装扮面试官" aria-label="装扮面试官">${pencil}</button>`}${character(h)}<span id="j-examiner-status" class="ji-status">Milo · 面试官</span></div><div id="j-examiner-caption-panel" class="ji-caption" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-compact="${compact}"${compact?'':' hidden'}><p id="j-examiner-caption">${h(compact?'回答已保存，我们看看下一次可以怎样讲得更清楚。':'')}</p></div>${editor}`;
  }
  globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewer=Object.freeze({create,markup,handleAction,appearance:()=>({...appearance})});
})();

</script>
<script>
/* Interview workspace built from the current question and saved project evidence. */
(() => {
  'use strict';

  function projectPanel(state,h){
    const evidence=state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'
      ?globalThis.CareerJourneyCourses?.evidence?.(state.pmProject):null;
    if(!evidence)return '';
    const preview=evidence.preview;
    return `<section class="fi-evidence" aria-label="本次项目素材">
      <div class="fi-evidence-heading"><h2>作品原型</h2><span>本次项目素材</span></div>
      <article class="fi-prototype">
        <div class="fi-browser-bar" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
        <div class="fi-prototype-body"><h3>客服退款回复助手</h3>
          ${preview?`<div class="fi-prototype-cases">${evidence.tests.map(item=>`<span class="${item.id===preview.id?'is-shown':''}">${h(item.label)}</span>`).join('')}</div>
            <p class="fi-order">${h(preview.message)}</p>
            <div class="fi-prototype-result ${preview.passed?'is-passed':''}"><strong>${h(preview.status)}</strong><p>${h(preview.text)}</p>
              ${preview.basis?`<small>处理依据 · ${h(preview.basis)}</small>`:''}</div>`:
              '<p class="fi-order">原型已生成。回到练习运行用例后，可以在这里看到回复。</p>'}
          ${evidence.tests.length>1?`<details class="fi-evidence-details"><summary>查看所有已运行用例 · ${evidence.tests.length} 条</summary><ul aria-label="我跑过的用例">${evidence.tests.map(item=>`<li><strong>${h(item.label)}</strong><p>${h(item.text)}</p></li>`).join('')}</ul></details>`:''}
        </div>
      </article>
      <details class="fi-evidence-prompt" open><summary>刚才写的提示词</summary><div>${evidence.prompt.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map(line=>{
        const field=/^(任务|依据|边界|输出)\s*[:：]\s*(.*)$/.exec(line);
        return field?`<p><b>${h(field[1])}</b><span>${h(field[2])}</span></p>`:`<p>${h(line)}</p>`;
      }).join('')}</div></details>
    </section>`;
  }

  function questionLabel(round,index){
    return round.kind==='followup'?'Milo · 追问':index===0?'Milo · 第一问':'Milo · 第'+(index+1)+'问';
  }

  function transcript({state,M,h,audioFor}){
    const {answers,index}=state.interview;
    if(!index||!answers.length)return '';
    const start=Math.max(0,index-1);
    const render=(answer,i)=>{
      const round=M.roundFor(state,i);
      if(!round)return '';
      const text=answer.text.length>260?answer.text.slice(0,260)+'…':answer.text;
      return `<div class="fi-thread-pair"><article class="fi-bubble fi-question-history"><p class="fi-label">${questionLabel(round,i)}</p><p>${h(round.question)}</p></article>
        <article class="fi-bubble fi-answer-history"><p class="fi-label">我的回答</p><p>${h(text)}</p>
        ${text!==answer.text?`<details class="fi-evidence-details"><summary>展开完整回答</summary><p>${h(answer.text)}</p></details>`:''}
        ${answer.mode==='voice'?audioFor?.(round)||'':''}</article></div>`;
    };
    const older=answers.slice(0,start).map(render).join('');
    return `${older?`<details class="fi-history"><summary>更早的问答 · ${start} 轮</summary>${older}</details>`:''}${answers.slice(start,index).map((answer,i)=>render(answer,start+i)).join('')}`;
  }

  function render({state,M,h,btn,role,round,examinerMarkup,responseMarkup,audioFor}){
    const title=state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'?'把做过的项目讲给':'和';
    const suffix=state.roleId==='B-ai-pm'?'听':'练一次面试';
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-interview fi-interview" aria-labelledby="fi-title">
      <header class="ws-interview-heading fi-heading"><div><p class="ws-kicker">项目面试</p><h1 id="fi-title">${title} <span>Milo</span> ${suffix}</h1></div><div class="ws-interview-progress">
        <span class="ws-stage-pill">第${state.interview.attemptNumber||1}次 · 第${state.interview.index+1} / 6题</span>${btn('回到学习','RESUME_TRAINING','','ghost small')}</div></header>
      <div class="fi-layout"><aside class="fi-side">
        <div class="fi-profile"><section class="ws-examiner-card" aria-label="面试官互动区">${examinerMarkup}</section><div class="fi-identity"><h2>Milo</h2><p>${h(role.title)} · 模拟面试</p></div></div>
        ${projectPanel(state,h)}
      </aside><div class="fi-conversation">
        ${transcript({state,M,h,audioFor})}
        <article class="fi-bubble fi-current-question" aria-label="当前问题">
          <div class="fi-question-head"><p class="fi-label">${questionLabel(round,state.interview.index)}</p><div class="ws-question-tools">${btn('听题','SPEAK_QUESTION','','ghost small')}
            <details class="ws-interview-more"><summary>更多</summary><div>${btn('换个说法','EXAMINER_CLARIFY','','ghost small')}${btn('给我一点思路','EXAMINER_HINT','','ghost small')}${btn('停止朗读','STOP_EXAMINER','','ghost small')}${btn('考官声音：开','TOGGLE_EXAMINER_AUDIO','aria-pressed="true"','ghost small')}</div></details></div></div>
          <h2>${h(round.question)}</h2>
        </article>
        ${responseMarkup}
      </div></div>
    </section>`;
  }

  function feedback({state,round,h,btn,examinerMarkup,audioFor}){
    const index=state.interview.index;
    const answer=state.interview.answers[index];
    const characters=Array.from(answer.text);
    const excerpt=characters.length>180?characters.slice(0,180).join('')+'…':answer.text;
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-feedback fi-feedback" aria-labelledby="fi-feedback-title">
      <header class="ws-interview-heading fi-heading"><div><p class="ws-kicker">面试复盘 · 第${index+1} / 6 轮</p><h1 id="fi-feedback-title">这次回答，<span>哪里对，哪里要改？</span></h1></div><span class="ws-stage-pill">回答已保存</span></header>
      <div class="fi-recap-layout">
        <div class="fi-recap-left">
          <article class="fi-recap-card fi-quote" data-j-answer-dock>
            <p class="fi-label">刚才的回答</p>
            <blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(excerpt)}</blockquote>
            <details class="fi-evidence-details"><summary>回看原问题${excerpt!==answer.text?'和完整回答':''}</summary>
              <p>${h(round.question)}</p>
              ${excerpt!==answer.text?`<blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(answer.text)}</blockquote>`:''}
            </details>
            ${answer.mode==='voice'?audioFor?.(round)||'':''}
          </article>
          <article class="fi-recap-card fi-keep"><h2>回答重点</h2><p>${h(round.feedback.keep)}</p></article>
          <article class="fi-recap-card fi-improve"><h2>下次改进</h2><p>${h(round.feedback.improve)}</p></article>
        </div>
        <div class="fi-recap-right">
          <article class="fi-recap-card fi-suggestion">
            <div class="fi-suggestion-head"><h2>下次可以这样答</h2>${examinerMarkup?btn('听改进建议','SPEAK_FEEDBACK','','ghost small'):''}</div>
            <p>${h(round.suggestedAnswer)}</p>

          </article>
          <p class="fi-next-practice"><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span> <strong>下一项练习</strong> ${h(round.feedback.nextTry)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn(index===5?'查看准备报告 →':round.kind==='main'?'听听 Milo 的追问 →':'进入下一个面试主题 →','NEXT_QUESTION')}${btn('回看我的训练记录','SHOW_REVIEW','','ghost')}</div>
    </section>`;
  }

  globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewViews=Object.freeze({render,feedback});
})();

  async function recoverPortrait(){
    // An older local session retained resume text before photo extraction was
    // introduced. Match that exact document to an optional private local cache.
    // Standalone file:// copies and unrelated documents make no request.
    if(state.profile?.photo||!state.profile?.sourceText||location.protocol!=='http:'||!['127.0.0.1','localhost'].includes(location.hostname)||!globalThis.crypto?.subtle)return;
    const source=state.profile.sourceText,version=photoGeneration;
    try{
      const value=source.normalize('NFKC').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu,'').toLowerCase();
      const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(value));
      const fingerprint=Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest),byte=>byte.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      const response=await fetch('/api/resume-photo?fingerprint='+fingerprint,{cache:'no-store'});
      if(!response.ok)return;
      const result=await response.json();
      if(version!==photoGeneration||state.profile?.sourceText!==source||state.profile.photo)return;
      if(result.photo)dispatch({type:'SET_RESUME_PHOTO',photo:result.photo});
    }catch{/* No recovery record is needed for ordinary resume imports. */}
  }

  }

  function field(label,path,value,type='text'){return `<label class="j-field"><span>${h(label)}</span>${type==='area'?`<textarea data-profile-field="${path}" rows="3">${h(Array.isArray(value)?value.join('\n'):value)}</textarea>`:`<input data-profile-field="${path}" value="${h(value||'')}" maxlength="300">`}</label>`;}
  function editor(){const p=resumeDisplayProfile();return `<form id="j-profile-editor" class="j-card"><h2>核对并修改简历</h2><div class="j-form-grid">${field('姓名','name',p.name)}${field('简历标题','headline',p.headline)}${field('电子邮箱','email',p.email)}${field('联系电话','phone',p.phone)}${field('意向岗位','goal',p.goal)}</div>${field('个人简介','summary',p.summary||'','area')}${p.education.map((e,i)=>`<h3>教育背景 ${i+1}</h3><div class="j-form-grid">${field('学校',`education.${i}.school`,e.school)}${field('时间',`education.${i}.period`,e.period)}${field('专业',`education.${i}.major`,e.major)}${field('学历',`education.${i}.degree`,e.degree)}</div>${field('课程与教育补充 · 每行一项',`education.${i}.details`,e.details,'area')}`).join('')}${p.experiences.map((e,i)=>`<h3>工作与项目 ${i+1}</h3><div class="j-form-grid">${field('单位 / 项目',`experiences.${i}.organization`,e.organization)}${field('负责角色',`experiences.${i}.role`,e.role)}${field('时间',`experiences.${i}.period`,e.period)}</div>${field('职责与成果 · 每行一项',`experiences.${i}.bullets`,e.bullets,'area')}`).join('')}${field('技能 · 每行一项','skills',p.skills,'area')}<p class="j-muted">仅保存你核对过的信息；之后确认资料，再回首页继续。</p><div class="j-actions">${btn('保存修改','SAVE_PROFILE')}${btn('取消','CANCEL_EDIT','','secondary')}</div></form>`;}
  function resume(){

    if(custom)return custom;
    const polish=state.resumePolish,isPolished=Boolean(polish&&state.resumeView==='polished');
    return `<section class="j-screen">${heading(state.onboardingComplete?'我的简历':'第 2 步 · class="gh-extraction-note"><strong>这几处需要你确认</strong><ul>${state.profile.extractionWarnings.map(text=>`<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div>`:''}${state.error?`<p class="j-error" '+(isPolished?'is-selected':''))}</div>`:btn('优化并美化简历','OPTIMIZE_RESUME')}${btn(isPolished?'导出美化版PDF':'导出PDF简历','EXPORT_PDF','','secondary')}${btn(editing?'收起修改':isPolished?'修改这版内容':'修改简历','EDIT_RESUME','','ghost')}<label class="j-btn secondary jr-photo-input">${state.profile.photo?'更换简历照片':'添加简历照片'}<input id="journey-photo-file" type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" aria-label="${state.profile.photo?'更换简历照片':'添加简历照片'}"></label></div>${isPolished?globalThis.CareerJourneyResumeViews?.changes(polish,{h})||'':''}<div →':state.careerPreferences?'确认资料，返回首页':'确认资料，继续 →',isPolished?'APPLY_AND_CONFIRM_RESUME':'CONFIRM_RESUME')}${polish?btn('恢复优化前内容','RESTORE_ORIGINAL_RESUME','','ghost small'):''}<label class="j-replace-file">换一份简历<input id="journey-replace-file" type="file" accept=".pdf,.docx,.txt,.md"></label></aside></div>${uploadError?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(uploadError)}</p>`:''}</section>`;
  }
  function paths(){return `<section class="j-screen">${heading('CHOOSE 下一步',`${state.profile.name}，你想先从哪里开始？`,'两种准备方式，可以随时回来切换。')}<div class="j-path-cards"><article class="j-path-card"><span class="j-path-letter">A</span><span class="j-role-icon">${icon('case')}</span><h2>看看适合我的岗位</h2><p>从已有经历和技能出发，找到更容易切入的工作，练清楚岗位任务和面试表达。</p>${btn('查看经历推荐 →','CHOOSE_A')}</article><article class="j-path-card"><span class="j-path-letter">B</span><span class="j-role-icon">${icon('chart')}</span><h2>准备我想去的方向</h2><p>写下意向岗位和求职日期，从学习计划开始，逐步补上目前缺少的能力。</p>${btn('填写意向，制定计划 →','CHOOSE_B')}</article></div><div class="j-actions">${btn('回看我的简历','SHOW_RESUME','','ghost')}</div></section>`;}
  function intent(){const start=today(),end=state.intent.deadline||addDays(start,84);return `<section class="j-screen j-intent-screen">${heading('YOUR TARGET','你想准备哪个岗位？','先确定方向和时间，学习计划才能落到每一周。')}<form id="j-intent-form" class="j-card"><label class="j-field"><span>意向岗位</span><select id="j-goal">${D.rolesB.map(item=>`<option value="${h(item.title)}" ${item.title===(state.intent.goal||state.profile.goal)?'selected':''}>${h(item.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="j-field"><span>计划什么时候开始求职？</span><input type="date" id="j-deadline" min="${addDays(start,1)}" max="${addDays(start,366)}" value="${h(end)}" required></label><label class="j-field"><span>每周可以投入多少小时？</span><div class="j-input-unit"><input id="j-hours" type="number" min="1" max="40" value="${state.intent.hoursPerWeek||6}" required><span>小时 / 周</span></div></label>${state.error?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>`:''}<div class="j-actions">${btn('查看意向方向 →','SAVE_INTENT')}${btn('返回选择','GO_PATHS','','ghost')}</div></form></section>`;}
  function roles(){let items=state.branch==='A'?D.rolesA:[...D.rolesB].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.title===state.intent.goal)-Number(a.title===state.intent.goal));return `<section class="j-screen">${heading(state.branch==='A'?'BASED ON YOUR EXPERIENCE':'TOWARD YOUR GOAL',state.branch==='A'?'从你的经历，找到可以切入的工作。':`围绕「${state.intent.goal}」的三个方向`,state.branch==='A'?'这里看的是经历如何迁移，以及真正上岗前还要补什么。':`计划在 ${state.intent.deadline} 开始求职；先选一个方向，再展开对应的学习计划。`)}<div class="j-role-grid">${items.map(item=>`<article class="j-role-card"><span class="j-role-icon">${icon(item.route==='A'?'case':'chart')}</span><h2>${h(item.title)}</h2><p class="j-role-rationale">${h(item.rationale)}</p><div class="j-role-glance"><strong>可以发挥的优势</strong><p>${h(item.strengths[0])}</p><strong>需要提前准备</strong><p>${h(item.risks[0])}</p></div>${btn('了解这个岗位 →','OPEN_ROLE',`data-role-id="${h(item.id)}"`)}</article>`).join('')}</div><div class="j-actions">${btn('换一种准备方式','GO_PATHS','','ghost')}</div></section>`;}

  function plan(){const value=M.planFor(state);return `<section class="j-screen">${heading('A PLAN YOU CAN FOLLOW',`${role().title} · 我的学习计划`,value.summary)}<div class="j-plan-summary"><div><small>准备时间</small><strong>${value.days}天</strong></div><div><small>每周安排</small><strong>${value.hoursPerWeek}小时</strong></div><div><small>求职日期</small><strong>${h(state.intent.deadline)}</strong></div></div><div class="j-plan-timeline">${value.stages.map((stage,index)=>`<article class="j-plan-milestone"><span class="j-week-number">${index+1}</span><div><p class="j-eyebrow">第${stage.startDay}—${stage.endDay}天</p><h2>${h(stage.title)}</h2><p>${h(stage.goal)}</p><span class="j-chip">产出：${h(stage.deliverable)}</span></div></article>`).join('')}</div><details class="j-details j-card"><summary>查看每周任务表 · ${value.weeks}周</summary><div class="j-plan-weeks">${value.calendar.map(week=>`<div class="j-plan-week"><span>第${week.week}周 · ${h(addDays(state.intent.today,week.startDay-1))}—${h(addDays(state.intent.today,week.endDay-1))}</span><h3>${h(week.title)}</h3><p>${h(week.task)}</p><p><strong>交付：</strong>${h(week.deliverable)}</p><p><strong>复盘：</strong>${h(week.review)}</p></div>`).join('')}</div></details><div class="j-actions">${btn('从第一项练习开始 →','START_LEARNING')}${btn('下载学习计划表','DOWNLOAD_PLAN','','secondary')}${btn('调整方向或日期','CHOOSE_B','','ghost')}</div></section>`;}
  function table(selectable){const selected=state.lessonInput?.removed||[];return `<div class="j-table-wrap" tabindex="0"><table class="j-data-table"><caption>招聘申请记录</caption><thead><tr>${selectable?'<th>待核对</th>':''}<th>记录</th><th>申请ID</th><th>来源</th><th>获邀</th><th>到场</th></tr></thead><tbody>${D.dataset.rawRows.map(row=>`<tr class="${selected.includes(row.id)?'selected':''}">${selectable?`<td><input type="checkbox" data-j-row="${row.id}" aria-label="核对${row.id}" ${selected.includes(row.id)?'checked':''} ${state.lessonFeedback?.correct?'disabled':''}></td>`:''}<th scope="row">${row.id}</th><td>${row.applicationId}</td><td>${h(row.channel||'待核对')}</td><td>${row.invited===null?'—':row.invited?'是':'否'}</td><td>${row.attended===null?'—':row.attended?'是':'否'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;}
  function chart(grouped=false){const series=grouped?[['applications','申请','#759357'],['invited','获邀','#d9bd68'],['attended','到场','#46623b']]:[[chartMetric,chartMetric==='attended'?'到场':'申请','#759357']];return `<figure class="j-chart"><figcaption>${grouped?'招聘渠道的申请、获邀与到场':'各渠道'+series[0][1]+'数量'}（条）</figcaption><div class="j-chart-columns">${D.dataset.stats.channels.map(row=>`<div class="j-chart-column"><div class="j-chart-bars">${series.map(([key,label,colour])=>`<div class="j-chart-bar" style="height:${row[key]/4*100}%;background:${colour}" aria-label="${row.name}${label}${row[key]}条"><strong>${row[key]}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div><span>${row.name}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>${grouped?`<div class="j-chart-legend">${series.map(([,label,colour])=>`<span><i style="background:${colour}"></i>${label}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:''}<p class="j-muted">分析口径10条，数量从0开始比较。</p></figure>`;}
  function lessonVisual(lesson){const custom=globalThis.CareerJourneyCourses?.renderVisual?.(lesson,{h,icon});if(custom)return custom;const v=lesson.visual||{};if(v.type==='schedule')return `<div class="j-slots">${v.slots.map(slot=>`<div><strong>${h(slot.time)}</strong><span>面试官：可参加</span><span>候选人：待回复</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;if(v.type==='kanban')return `<div class="j-kanban">${v.columns.map((column,index)=>`<div><strong>${h(column)}</strong>${v.cards.filter(card=>card.column===index).map(card=>`<p>${h(card.label)}</p>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;if(v.type==='handoff')return `<div class="j-handoff">${v.items.map(item=>`<div><small>${h(item.label)}</small><strong>${h(item.value)}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div>`;if(v.type==='table')return table(false);if(lesson.kind==='clean')return `<div class="j-stats"><div class="j-stat"><strong>12</strong><span>原始记录</span></div><div class="j-stat"><strong>${state.lessonInput?.removed?.length||0}</strong><span>待核对</span></div><div class="j-stat"><strong>${12-(state.lessonInput?.removed?.length||0)}</strong><span>分析用记录</span></div></div>${table(true)}`;if(lesson.kind==='metric')return `<div class="j-stats"><div class="j-stat"><strong>10</strong><span>申请</span></div><div class="j-stat"><strong>5</strong><span>获邀</span></div><div class="j-stat"><strong>4</strong><span>到场</span></div></div><p class="j-formula">到场率 = 实际到场 ÷ 获邀面试 × 100%</p>`;if(lesson.kind==='chart')return chart();if(lesson.kind==='insight')return chart(true);if(lesson.kind==='brief')return `<div class="j-brief-blocks"><div><b>事实</b><p>10条申请，5人获邀，4人到场。</p></div><div><b>边界</b><p>样本量小，不能判断长期渠道表现。</p></div><div><b>下一步</b><p>选一个可以继续核对的行动。</p></div></div>`;return `<div class="j-task-flow"><span>业务问题</span>${icon('arrow')}<span>数据核验</span>${icon('arrow')}<span>有依据的结论</span></div>`;}

  function learn(){
    const list=lessons(),lesson=list[state.lessonIndex],feedback=state.lessonFeedback;
    const knowledge=reviewingKnowledge||!M.lessonStudied(state);
    const teaching=globalThis.CareerJourneyTeaching;
    const customTask=globalThis.CareerJourneyCourses?.renderTask?.(lesson,{state,h,btn});
    const feedbackTitle=lesson.practice==='refund-replies'?'两条回复已对照':customTask?'原型测试已记录':'这一步，做对了。';
    const exercise=customTask||`<div class="j-card j-lesson-visual">${lessonVisual(lesson)}</div>
      ${lesson.kind==='metric'?`<label class="j-field j-metric-field"><span>面试到场率是多少？</span><div class="j-input-unit"><input id="j-metric" type="text" inputmode="decimal" value="${h(typeof state.lessonInput==='string'?state.lessonInput.replace(/%\s*$/,''):'')}" placeholder="请输入百分数" ${feedback?.correct?'readonly':''}><span>%</span></div></label>`:lesson.kind==='clean'?'':`<div class="j-options">${lesson.options.map((option,index)=>`<button type="button" class="j-option ${state.lessonInput===option.id?'selected':''}" data-j-action="CHOOSE_LESSON" data-value="${h(option.id)}" aria-pressed="${state.lessonInput===option.id}"><b>${String.fromCharCode(65+index)}</b><span>${h(option.label)}${option.detail?`<small>${h(option.detail)}</small>`:''}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`}
    `;
    const task=`<div class="ws-task-head"><span class="ws-stage-pill">动手练习 ${state.lessonIndex+1} / ${list.length}</span><h2>${h(lesson.title)}</h2><p>${h(lesson.brief)}</p></div>${exercise}
      ${feedback?`<div class="j-feedback ${feedback.correct?'good':'retry'}" role="status"><h2>${feedback.correct?feedbackTitle:'再核对一下。'}</h2><p>${h(feedback.feedback)}</p></div>`:''}
      <div class="j-actions ws-task-actions">${feedback?.correct?btn(state.lessonReplay?'完成重练，返回课程 →':state.lessonIndex===list.length-1?'完成本项，回到学习看板 →':'完成本项，继续 →','FINISH_TASK'):btn(lesson.practice==='refund-replies'?'提交并对照':'检查这一项','CHECK_LESSON')}${completed().includes(lesson.id)&&!state.lessonReplay?btn('重新做这道题','RESTART_LESSON',`data-index="${state.lessonIndex}"`,'secondary'):''}${btn('回看本课知识','REVIEW_KNOWLEDGE','','ghost')}<details class="j-details"><summary>给我一点提示</summary><p>${h(lesson.hint)}</p></details></div>`;
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-learn">
      ${workspaceTop('LEARN, THEN TRY','先学明白，再动手做。',`${role().title} · 每一课先讲概念和例子，再用任务检验。`,completed().length,`/ ${list.length}项`,'已完成训练')}
      <div class="ws-learn-layout"><aside class="ws-course-map ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>我的训练路线</h2><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('book')}</span></div><p class="j-muted">先学知识，再做练习。也可以先面试，之后回来补学。</p><nav class="j-learn-steps" aria-label="岗位训练进度">${list.map((item,index)=>`<button class="j-learn-node ${index===state.lessonIndex?'current':''} ${index<completed().length?'done':''}" data-j-action="OPEN_LESSON" data-index="${index}" ${M.canOpenLesson(state,index)?'':'disabled'}><span>${index<completed().length?'✓':index+1}</span>${h(item.title)}</button>`).join('')}</nav><div class="j-actions">${state.branch==='B'?btn('回看学习计划','SHOW_PLAN','','ghost small'):btn('回看岗位方向','BACK_ROLES','','ghost small')}${btn(state.interview.finished?'再练一轮模拟面试':'先做一次模拟面试',state.interview.finished?'OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE':'START_INTERVIEW','','secondary small')}${btn('选择课程重新做题','OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER','','ghost small')}</div></aside>
      <article class="ws-task-workspace ws-panel">${knowledge&&teaching?teaching.render({state,M,D,h,icon,btn,lesson,role:role(),lessonIndex:state.lessonIndex,total:list.length,studyPage}):task}</article></div>
    </section>`;
  }
  function audioFor(round){const item=clips.get(round.id);return item?`<audio controls src="${h(item.url)}" aria-label="回听我的语音回答"></audio>`:'';}
  function projectEvidence(){
    if(state.roleId!=='B-ai-pm')return '';
    const evidence=globalThis.CareerJourneyCourses?.evidence?.(state.pmProject);
    if(!evidence)return '';
    return `<details class="j-details ws-project-evidence" open><summary>本次项目素材 · 客服退款回复助手</summary><div class="ws-project-columns"><div><h3>我写的提示词</h3><p class="ws-project-prompt">${h(evidence.prompt)}</p></div><div><h3>我跑过的用例</h3>${evidence.tests.length?`<ul>${evidence.tests.map(item=>`<li><strong>${h(item.label)}</strong><p>${h(item.text)}</p></li>`).join('')}</ul>`:'<p>还没有运行用例。</p>'}</div></div></details>`;
  }
  function interview(){
    const round=currentRound(),oldClip=clips.get(round.id);draft=state.interview.drafts?.[round.id]??draft;
    const examinerMarkup=globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewer?.markup({buddy,h,btn,round})||`<div class="ws-examiner-art">${buddy('thinking')}</div>`;
    const responseMarkup=`<section class="ws-response-card" aria-label="作答区"><div class="j-answer-modes ws-answer-tools" role="group" aria-label="回答方式">${btn('打字回答','ANSWER_MODE','data-mode="text" aria-pressed="'+(answerMode==='text')+'"',answerMode==='text'?'secondary':'ghost')}${btn('语音回答','ANSWER_MODE','data-mode="voice" aria-pressed="'+(answerMode==='voice')+'"',answerMode==='voice'?'secondary':'ghost')}</div>
      ${voiceError?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(voiceError)}</p>`:''}${answerMode==='voice'?`<div class="j-voice-panel"><div class="j-voice-orb ${recording?'recording':''}">${icon('mic')}</div><strong id="j-recording-time">${voicePending?'等待麦克风授权…':recording?'正在录音 · '+Math.floor((Date.now()-recordingStarted)/1000)+'秒':oldClip?'回答已录好 · '+oldClip.seconds+'秒':'准备好后，开始说吧。'}</strong><div class="j-actions">${btn(voicePending?'等待麦克风授权…':recording?'结束录音':oldClip?'重新录一遍':'开始录音',recording?'STOP_VOICE':'START_VOICE',voicePending?'disabled':'','secondary')}</div>${oldClip?audioFor(round):''}<p class="j-muted">录音保留在当前页面，可回听；刷新前可以补充文字，便于之后复盘。</p></div>`:''}
      <label class="j-field"><span>${answerMode==='voice'?'补充文字（可选）':'你的回答'}</span><textarea id="j-answer" class="j-answer-input" maxlength="4000" rows="6" placeholder="可以先讲具体情境，再说你采取的动作与依据。">${h(draft)}</textarea></label><p class="ws-draft-note">文字草稿会保留，回看训练或刷新后可以继续。</p>${state.error?`<p class="j-error" role="alert">${h(state.error)}</p>`:''}<div class="j-actions">${btn('提交回答 →','SUBMIT_ANSWER',recording||voicePending?'disabled':'')}</div></section>`;
    const film=globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewViews?.render?.({state,M,h,btn,role:role(),round,examinerMarkup,responseMarkup,audioFor});
    if(film)return film;
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-interview"><header class="ws-interview-heading"><div><p class="ws-kicker">模拟面试</p><h2>${h(role().title)} · 模拟面试</h2></div><div class="ws-interview-progress"><span class="ws-stage-pill">第${state.interview.attemptNumber||1}次 · 第${state.interview.index+1} / 6题</span>${btn('回到学习','RESUME_TRAINING','','ghost small')}</div></header><article class="ws-interview-session ws-panel"><div class="ws-interview-prompt">
      <section class="ws-examiner-card" aria-label="面试官互动区">${examinerMarkup}</section>
      <article class="ws-question-card"><div class="ws-panel-head"><span class="ws-stage-pill">${round.kind==='followup'?'继续追问':'本轮问题'}</span><div class="ws-question-tools">${btn('听题','SPEAK_QUESTION','','ghost small')}<details class="ws-interview-more"><summary>更多</summary><div>${btn('换个说法','EXAMINER_CLARIFY','','ghost small')}${btn('给我一点思路','EXAMINER_HINT','','ghost small')}${btn('停止朗读','STOP_EXAMINER','','ghost small')}${btn('考官声音：开','TOGGLE_EXAMINER_AUDIO','aria-pressed="true"','ghost small')}</div></details></div></div><h1>${h(round.question)}</h1></article></div>
      ${projectEvidence()}${responseMarkup}</article></section>`;
  }
  function feedback(){
    const round=currentRound(),answer=state.interview.answers[state.interview.index];
    const answerChars=Array.from(answer.text),excerpt=answerChars.length>180?answerChars.slice(0,180).join('')+'…':answer.text;
    const examinerMarkup=globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewer?.markup({buddy,h,btn,round,compact:true});
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-feedback ws-film-recap"><header class="ws-interview-heading"><div><p class="ws-kicker">面试复盘 · 第${state.interview.index+1} / 6 轮</p><h1>这次回答，<span class="ws-recap-accent">哪里对，哪里要改？</span></h1></div><span class="ws-stage-pill">回答已保存</span></header>
      <div class="ws-recap-grid"><div class="ws-recap-main"><article class="ws-panel ws-recap-quote" data-j-answer-dock><p class="ws-kicker">刚才的回答</p><blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(excerpt)}</blockquote><details class="j-details ws-answer-evidence"><summary>回看问题和我的回答</summary><h3>${h(round.question)}</h3>${excerpt!==answer.text?`<blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(answer.text)}</blockquote>`:''}${answer.mode==='voice'?audioFor(round):''}</details></article>
      <div class="ws-feedback-layout"><article class="ws-feedback-focus"><h2>回答重点</h2><p>${h(round.feedback.keep)}</p></article><article class="ws-panel"><h2>下一次改进</h2><p>${h(round.feedback.improve)}</p></article></div></div>
      <aside class="ws-panel ws-recap-coach"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>下次可以这样答</h2>${examinerMarkup?btn('听改进建议','SPEAK_FEEDBACK','','ghost small'):''}</div><div class="sr-only">${examinerMarkup||''}</div><p>${h(round.suggestedAnswer)}</p><div class="ws-next-try"><h3>下一项练习</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.nextTry)}</p></div></aside></div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn(state.interview.index===5?'完成准备，带上信心出发 →':round.kind==='main'?'听听面试官的追问 →':'进入下一个面试主题 →','NEXT_QUESTION')}${btn('回看我的训练记录','SHOW_REVIEW','','ghost')}</div></section>`;
  }
  function roundEvidence(index,withAudio=true,report=shownReport()){const round=M.roundFor(report,index),answer=report.interview.answers[index],live=report.roleId===state.roleId&&report.interview.attemptNumber===state.interview.attemptNumber;return `<details class="ws-panel ws-report-round"><summary><span class="ws-report-round-number">${String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span><small>${round.kind==='followup'?'继续追问':'主题问题'}</small><strong>${h(round.question)}</strong></span><span class="ws-report-expand">＋</span></summary><div class="ws-round-body"><h3>我的回答</h3><blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(answer.text)}</blockquote>${withAudio&&answer.mode==='voice'?(live?audioFor(round):'<p class="j-muted">保留了文字记录；当时的录音仅在原页面中可回听。</p>'):''}<div class="ws-round-notes"><div><h3>回答重点</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.keep)}</p></div><div><h3>下次改进</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.improve)}</p></div><div><h3>再练一次</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.nextTry)}</p></div></div></div></details>`;}
  function reportPicker(report=shownReport()){
    const items=reports();if(items.length<2)return '';
    return `<nav class="ws-report-picker" aria-label="选择面试报告">${items.map(item=>btn(`第${item.attemptNumber}次报告`,'VIEW_REPORT',`data-report-id="${h(item.id)}" aria-pressed="${item.id===report.activeReportId}"`,'secondary small')).join('')}</nav>`;
  }
  function finish(){
    const report=shownReport(),list=M.lessonsFor(report.roleId),answers=report.interview.answers,next=D.nextSteps?.[report.roleId]||[],first=answers[0],completed=()=>report.completedLessons[report.branch]||[],role=()=>M.roleFor(report.roleId);
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-report"><div class="ws-page-top"><header class="ws-hero ws-report-hero"><p class="ws-kicker">我的准备报告</p><span class="ws-stage-pill">${h(role().title)} · 第${report.interview.attemptNumber||1}次面试已完成</span><h1 class="ws-title">准备好了，下一站见。</h1><p class="ws-description">${M.trainingDone(report)?'你已完成这一轮知识练习与模拟面试。带上整理好的经历与改进清单，继续准备真实面试。':'这一轮模拟面试已完成。还没学完的课程会保留在学习计划里，接下来按需要补学和复盘。'}</p></header><aside class="ws-overview ws-report-summary"><p class="ws-stat-label">本轮准备记录</p><div class="ws-metrics-grid"><div><strong>${completed().length}<small>/ ${list.length}</small></strong><span>已完成训练</span></div><div><strong>${answers.length}<small>/ 6</small></strong><span>已保存回答</span></div></div><p class="ws-stat-note">${report.branch==='B'?`意向求职日期 ${h(report.intent.deadline)}`:'从已有经历出发，完成一轮岗位准备。'}</p></aside></div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn('再练一轮模拟面试 →','OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE')}${btn('选择课程重新做题','OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER','','secondary')}${btn('下载可打印报告','DOWNLOAD_REPORT_HTML')}${btn('下载准备记录','DOWNLOAD_REPORT','','secondary')}</div>
      ${reportPicker(report)}<div class="ws-report-grid"><article class="ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>知识与情境练习</h2><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('book')}</span></div><p class="ws-stat-note">实际完成 ${completed().length} / ${list.length} 项知识与情境练习</p>${completed().length?`<ul class="ws-completed-list">${list.filter(item=>completed().includes(item.id)).map(item=>`<li>${icon('check')}<span>${h(item.title)}</span></li>`).join('')}</ul>`:'<p>这一轮先进行面试，尚未完成课程练习。</p>'}${completed().length<list.length?`<p>还有 ${list.length-completed().length} 项训练，保留在学习计划中。</p>${btn('回到学习计划补学','RESUME_TRAINING','','secondary')}`:''}</article><article class="ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>表达与证据</h2><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('chat')}</span></div><p class="ws-stat-note">第1轮回答摘录</p>${first?`<blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(first.text.length>110?first.text.slice(0,110)+'…':first.text)}</blockquote>`:''}<p>下方保留了每一轮的问题、原回答和复盘要点，方便逐项复看。作品集中的访谈、原型与评测，仍需按学习计划实际完成。</p></article><article class="ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>下一步改进</h2><span class="ws-section-icon">${icon('star')}</span></div><ul class="ws-next-step-list">${next.map(text=>`<li>${h(text.replace(/^\d+[.、\s]+/,''))}</li>`).join('')}</ul></article></div>
      <div class="ws-section-heading"><div><p class="ws-kicker">回看面试</p><h2>六轮问答，逐轮回看。</h2></div><span class="ws-stage-pill">点击展开原回答与复盘</span></div><div class="ws-report-timeline">${answers.map((_,index)=>roundEvidence(index,true,report)).join('')}</div>
      <div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${btn('再探索一个方向','GO_PATHS','','secondary')}${btn('回到准备概览','SHOW_HOME','','ghost')}</div></section>`;
  }
  function review(){
    const type=state.review.type,index=state.review.index;let detail='';
    if(type==='lesson'){const item=lessons()[index];detail=`<article class="ws-panel"><span class="ws-stage-pill">知识复盘</span><h2>${h(item.title)}</h2><p>${h(item.explain)}</p><p><strong>下一次注意：</strong>${h(item.hint)}</p>${btn('重新做这一课','RESTART_LESSON',`data-index="${index}"`,'secondary')}${btn('复习本课知识','OPEN_KNOWLEDGE',`data-index="${index}"`,'ghost small')}</article>`;}
    if(type==='interview'){const round=M.roundFor(state,index),answer=state.interview.answers[index];detail=`<article class="ws-panel"><span class="ws-stage-pill">面试复盘</span><h2>${h(round.question)}</h2><blockquote class="j-answer-quote">${h(answer.text)}</blockquote>${answer.mode==='voice'?audioFor(round):''}<h3>下次改进</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.improve)}</p><h3>再练一次</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.nextTry)}</p></article>`;}
    const continueButton=state.interview.finished?btn('再练一轮模拟面试','OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE'):M.canInterview(state)?btn('继续模拟面试','START_INTERVIEW'):btn('继续岗位训练','RESUME_TRAINING');
    return `<section class="j-screen ws-page ws-review">${workspaceTop('REVISIT AND IMPROVE','每一次复盘，都会更进一步。','知识与面试回答放在一起，找到下一次最值得改进的一步。',completed().length+state.interview.answers.length,'项记录','本轮已留下')}
      <div class="ws-review-grid"><section class="ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>知识复盘</h2><span class="ws-stage-pill">${completed().length} / ${lessons().length}</span></div><div class="j-review-list">${lessons().map((item,index)=>index<completed().length?btn(item.title,'REVIEW_LESSON',`data-index="${index}"`,'ghost ws-review-row'):'').join('')||'<p class="ws-stat-note">完成训练后，就可以在这里回看。</p>'}</div></section><section class="ws-panel"><div class="ws-panel-head"><h2>面试复盘</h2><span class="ws-stage-pill">${state.interview.answers.length} / 6</span></div><div class="j-review-list">${state.interview.answers.map((answer,index)=>btn(`第${index+1}轮 · ${M.roundFor(state,index).kind==='followup'?'追问':'主题问题'}`,'REVIEW_INTERVIEW',`data-index="${index}"`,'ghost ws-review-row')).join('')||'<p class="ws-stat-note">完成回答后，就可以在这里回看。</p>'}</div></section></div>${detail?`<div class="ws-review-detail">${detail}</div>`:''}<div class="j-actions ws-page-actions">${continueButton}${btn('选择课程重新做题','OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER','','secondary')}${reports().length?btn('查看已完成的报告','BACK_FINISH','','ghost'):''}${btn('下载准备记录','DOWNLOAD_REPORT','','secondary')}${state.branch==='B'?btn('回看学习计划','SHOW_PLAN','','ghost'):''}</div></section>`;
  }
  function reportHTML(){
    const report=shownReport(),role=()=>M.roleFor(report.roleId),lessons=()=>M.lessonsFor(report.roleId),completed=()=>report.completedLessons[report.branch]||[];
    const rounds=report.interview.answers.map((answer,index)=>{const round=M.roundFor(report,index);return `<section><p class="label">第${index+1}轮 · ${round.kind==='followup'?'继续追问':'主题问题'}</p><h2>${h(round.question)}</h2><h3>我的回答</h3><blockquote>${h(answer.text)}</blockquote><h3>回答重点</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.keep)}</p><h3>下次改进</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.improve)}</p><h3>再练一次</h3><p>${h(round.feedback.nextTry)}</p></section>`;}).join('');
    return `<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${h(report.profile.name)} · ${h(role().title)} · RoleReady 求职准备报告</title><style>body{margin:0;background:#f6f7ef;color:#252b20;font:18px/1.8 system-ui,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}main{max-width:960px;margin:32px auto;padding:0 24px}header{padding:32px;background:#3e5131;color:white;border-radius:28px}h1{font-size:34px;line-height:1.4}h2{font-size:24px}h3{font-size:18px}section{background:white;border-radius:24px;padding:28px;margin-top:24px;break-inside:avoid}blockquote{margin:16px 0;padding:20px;background:#f0f3e7;border-left:4px solid #8aa16d;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.label{color:#58614d}header .label{color:white}li{margin:8px 0}@media print{body{background:white}main{margin:0;max-width:none;padding:0}header{color:#252b20;background:#eef2e4}section{border:1px solid #e1e6d7;border-radius:12px}header .label{color:#58614d}}</style><main><header><p class="label">RoleReady · 求职准备报告</p><h1>${h(report.profile.name)} · ${h(role().title)}</h1><p>第${report.interview.attemptNumber||1}次面试报告</p><p>已完成训练 ${completed().length}/${lessons().length} · 已保存回答 ${report.interview.answers.length}/6</p>${report.branch==='B'?`<p>求职日期：${h(report.intent.deadline)} · 每周计划投入：${report.intent.hoursPerWeek}小时</p>`:''}</header><section><h2>已完成的知识与情境练习</h2><p>这里记录课程练习与面试回答；完整学习计划中的访谈、原型与评测，仍需实际产出和复核。计划工时不计为已完成时长。</p><ul>${lessons().filter(item=>completed().includes(item.id)).map(item=>`<li>${h(item.title)}<p>${h(item.explain)}</p></li>`).join('')}</ul></section>${rounds}<section><h2>下一步改进</h2><ul>${(D.nextSteps?.[report.roleId]||[]).map(text=>`<li>${h(text)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></section></main></html>`;
  }

  function aboutPanel(){return `<section class="j-about" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="j-about-title"><div class="j-card"><h2 id="j-about-title">${h(D.productInfo.title)}</h2><p>${h(D.productInfo.body)}</p><p>语音回答只在你点击录音并授权麦克风后采集，录音留在当前页面，不发送给AI；浏览器关闭后不会保留音频。简历和文字准备记录保存在当前浏览器，可使用“重新开始”清除本流程记录。</p>${btn('知道了，继续准备','CLOSE_ABOUT')}</div></section>`;}
  function guidePanel(){return `<section class="j-about fd-guide" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="fd-guide-title"><div class="j-card"><span class="j-chip">下一步</span><h2 id="fd-guide-title">把下一步，走得更清楚。</h2><p>先上传简历，核对并优化经历，再补充当前求职意向与准备时间。随后选择准备方式：A从已有经历推荐岗位，B只围绕你填写的意向制定学习计划。</p><div class="fd-guide-steps"><div><b>01</b><span>上传简历</span></div><div><b>02</b><span>核对个人资料</span></div><div><b>03</b><span>选择岗位方向</span></div><div><b>04</b><span>先学知识，再做练习</span></div><div><b>05</b><span>模拟面试与准备报告</span></div></div><p class="j-muted">顶部可以查找准备模块；选好岗位后，也可以直接进入模拟面试，未完成的学习会留到看板继续。完成面试后，首页会切换成学习计划与打卡看板。阅读字号与动态开关在右上角设置中。</p>${btn('知道了，开始准备','CLOSE_GUIDE')}</div></section>`;}
  function render(){
    const views={upload,import:importPage,resume,paths,intent,roles,role:rolePage,plan,learn,practice:practiceCenter,interviewReady:interviewPractice,interview,feedback,finish,review,learning:learningRecords,compare:resumeCompare};
    const workspace=globalThis.CareerJourneyWorkspaceViews;
    if(workspace){const ctx={state,D,M,h,icon,btn,heading,role:role(),lessons:lessons(),completed:completed(),today,addDays};for(const name of ['paths','intent','roles','role','plan'])views[name]=()=>workspace[name](ctx);}
    if(globalThis.CareerJourneyPreferences)views.preferences=()=>globalThis.CareerJourneyPreferences.render({state,D,M,h,icon,btn,today,addDays});
    $('#journey-app').innerHTML=cardGuidance()+(views[state.screen]||upload)()+(about?aboutPanel():'')+(guide?guidePanel():'');
    checkInCelebrationDate=null;
    if(state.screen==='interview'){
      const caption=$('#j-examiner-caption-panel');
      if(caption)($('.fi-current-question')||$('.ws-interview-prompt'))?.insertAdjacentElement?.('afterend',caption);
    }
    document.body.classList.toggle('j-large-text',state.textSize==='large');
    if(document.body.dataset)document.body.dataset.jScreen=state.screen;
    document.querySelectorAll?.('[data-j-text-size]')?.forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(button.dataset.jTextSize===state.textSize)));
    const names={upload:state.onboardingComplete?'我的工作台':'五步准备',import:'上传简历',learning:'学习记录',compare:'简历对比',resume:'我的简历',preferences:'填写求职意向',paths:'选择准备方向',intent:'准备时间与目标',roles:'岗位推荐',role:'岗位任务',plan:'学习计划',learn:'岗位训练',practice:'课程练习',interviewReady:'面试练习',interview:'模拟面试',feedback:'面试复盘',finish:'准备报告',review:'我的复盘'};
    document.title=`${names[state.screen]} · RoleReady`;
    const step=['import','resume','compare'].includes(state.screen)?'resume':['preferences','paths','intent','roles','role'].includes(state.screen)?'paths':['plan','learn','practice','learning'].includes(state.screen)?'prepare':['interview','interviewReady'].includes(state.screen)?'interview':'finish';
    const activeStep=state.screen==='import'?1:state.screen==='resume'||state.screen==='compare'?2:['preferences','paths','intent','roles','role'].includes(state.screen)?3:['plan','learn','learning','practice'].includes(state.screen)||state.screen==='review'&&!M.trainingDone(state)?4:5;
    $('#j-progress-steps').innerHTML=state.screen==='upload'?'':M.onboardingSteps(state).map(item=>`<span class="${item.id===activeStep?'current':''} ${item.status==='done'&&!item.skipped?'done':''} ${item.skipped?'skipped':''}" ${item.id===activeStep?'aria-current="step"':''}><b>${item.skipped?'↺':item.status==='done'?'✓':item.id}</b><span class="j-step-label">${h(item.title)}${item.skipped?' · 待补学':''}</span></span>`).join('');
    const rail=$('#j-side-rail');
    if(rail){
      const stageFor={SHOW_RESUME:'resume',GO_PATHS:'paths',SHOW_DIRECTION:'paths',RESUME_TRAINING:'prepare',START_INTERVIEW:'interview',SHOW_REVIEW:'finish'};
      const brandDotColors=['#b59645','#aa9749','#9b984d','#8c9650','#7c9350','#6d8c4c','#5e8549'];
      const brandDots=[1,3,5,7,5,3,1].flatMap((count,row)=>Array.from({length:count},(_,column)=>{
        const x=50+(column-(count-1)/2)*12.5;
        const y=12.5+row*12.5;
        const tone=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Math.round((x+y-62.5)/75*6)));
        return `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${x===50&&y===50?5.4:5}" fill="${brandDotColors[tone]}"/>`;
      })).join('');
      const dotmark=`<svg class="fd-dotmark" viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true">${brandDots}</svg>`;
      const railItem=(label,action,glyph,{current=false,ready=true,hint='',brand=false,avatar=false}={})=>{
        const id='j-rail-tip-'+action.toLowerCase()+(brand?'-brand':avatar?'-avatar':'');
        const tooltip=`<span class="j-rail-tooltip" id="${id}" role="tooltip"><strong>${h(label)}</strong>${!ready&&hint?`<small>${h(hint)}</small>`:''}</span>`;
        return `<span class="j-rail-item ${avatar?'is-avatar':''}" ${ready?'':`tabindex="0" aria-describedby="${id}"`}><button type="button" class="${brand?'fd-rail-brand':avatar?'fd-user-avatar':'fd-rail-button'} ${current?'current':''}" data-j-action="${action}" aria-label="${h(label)}" aria-describedby="${id}" ${current?'aria-current="page"':''} ${ready?'':'disabled'}>${brand?dotmark:avatar?(state.profile?.photo?`<img src="${h(state.profile.photo.dataUrl)}" alt="我的简历照片">`:h(state.profile?.name?.slice(-1)||'向')):icon(glyph)}</button>${tooltip}</span>`;
      };
      rail.innerHTML=railItem('RoleReady 首页','SHOW_HOME','home',{brand:true})+`<nav class="fd-rail-nav" aria-label="准备模块">`+railItem('准备概览','SHOW_HOME','home',{current:state.screen==='upload'})+dashboardRoutes().filter(item=>item.action!=='SHOW_PLAN').map(item=>railItem(item.label,item.action,item.glyph,{ready:item.ready,hint:item.hint,current:state.screen!=='upload'&&(state.screen==='review'?item.action==='SHOW_REVIEW':stageFor[item.action]===step)})).join('')+`</nav><div class="fd-rail-bottom">`+railItem('准备指南','OPEN_GUIDE','book')+railItem('产品说明','ABOUT','info')+railItem('返回准备概览','SHOW_HOME','home',{avatar:true})+'</div>';
    }
    const greet=$('#j-header-greeting'),caption=$('#j-header-caption');if(greet)greet.textContent=state.profile?.name?`你好，${state.profile.name}！`:'你好，欢迎来做求职准备。';if(caption)caption.textContent=state.screen==='upload'?(state.onboardingComplete?'你的资料、学习和求职准备，都在这里。':'先点亮第一步，再一步一步走向目标。'):`${names[state.screen]} · 按自己的节奏，一步一步准备。`;
    closeSearch();
    examiner?.sync();
    try{history.replaceState(null,'','#'+state.screen);}catch{/* Local file viewers may restrict history. */}
  }
  function stopCapture(){
    if(!recording&&!voicePending)return;
    voiceGeneration++;voicePending=false;clearInterval(timer);
    if(recorder?.state==='recording')recorder.stop();
    stream?.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop());recording=false;
  }
  async function startVoice(){
    if(recording||voicePending)return;
    const round=currentRound();draft=$('#j-answer')?.value||draft;voiceError='';
    if(!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia||typeof MediaRecorder==='undefined'){
      voiceError='当前浏览器没有提供录音功能，请使用打字回答。';answerMode='text';render();return;
    }
    examiner?.stop();
    const generation=++voiceGeneration;voicePending=true;render();
    try{
      const acquired=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});
      if(generation!==voiceGeneration){acquired.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop());return;}
      stream=acquired;voicePending=false;const chunks=[],activeRecorder=new MediaRecorder(acquired);recorder=activeRecorder;
      activeRecorder.ondataavailable=event=>{if(event.data?.size)chunks.push(event.data);};
      activeRecorder.onstop=()=>{
        acquired.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop());
        if(generation!==voiceGeneration)return;
        clearInterval(timer);
        recording=false;examiner?.stop();const blob=new Blob(chunks,{type:activeRecorder.mimeType||'audio/webm'});
        if(blob.size){const previous=clips.get(round.id);if(previous)URL.revokeObjectURL(previous.url);clips.set(round.id,{url:URL.createObjectURL(blob),seconds:Math.max(1,Math.round((Date.now()-recordingStarted)/1000))});}
        else voiceError='这次没有录到声音，请再试一次，或改用打字回答。';
        render();
      };
      activeRecorder.start();recording=true;recordingStarted=Date.now();render();examiner?.listen();
      timer=setInterval(()=>{const el=$('#j-recording-time');if(el)el.textContent='正在录音 · '+Math.floor((Date.now()-recordingStarted)/1000)+'秒';},1000);
    }catch{
      if(generation!==voiceGeneration)return;
      stream?.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop());voicePending=false;recording=false;
      voiceError='没有取得麦克风权限。你可以允许后再试，或使用打字回答。';render();
    }
  }
  function releaseVoice(){voicePending=false;voiceError='';voiceGeneration++;clearInterval(timer);if(recorder?.state==='recording')recorder.stop();stream?.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop());recording=false;for(const item of clips.values())URL.revokeObjectURL(item.url);clips.clear();}
  document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(timeControl(event))return;if(event.target.id==='j-answer'){draft=event.target.value;state=M.reduce(state,{type:'SET_ANSWER_DRAFT',text:draft});persist();}if(event.target.id==='j-module-search')refreshSearch(event.target.value);if(event.target.dataset?.pmField){state=M.reduce(state,{type:'SET_PM_PROJECT',field:event.target.dataset.pmField,value:event.target.value});persist();}});
  document.addEventListener('wheel',timeControl,{passive:false});
  document.addEventListener('focusin',event=>{if(event.target.id==='j-module-search')refreshSearch(event.target.value);});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(timeControl(event))return;if(event.key==='Escape'){if(document.querySelector('#j-examiner-editor')?.open)globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewer?.handleAction('CLOSE_EXAMINER_EDITOR');closeSearch();if(about||guide){about=false;guide=false;render();}}});
  document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(timeControl(event))return;const node=event.target;if(node.id==='journey-photo-file'&&node.files?.length){importPhoto(node.files[0]);return;}if(['journey-file','journey-replace-file'].includes(node.id)&&node.files?.length)importFile(node.files[0]);if(node.dataset?.jRow){const removed=new Set(state.lessonInput?.removed||[]);if(node.checked)removed.add(node.dataset.jRow);else removed.delete(node.dataset.jRow);dispatch({type:'SET_LESSON_INPUT',value:{removed:[...removed]}});}});
  document.addEventListener('dragover',event=>{
    const drop=event.target.closest?.('[data-j-resume-drop]');
    if(drop&&Array.from(event.dataTransfer?.types||[]).includes('Files')){event.preventDefault();event.dataTransfer.dropEffect='copy';drop.classList.add('is-dragging');}
  });
  document.addEventListener('dragleave',event=>{
    const drop=event.target.closest?.('[data-j-resume-drop]');
    if(drop&&(!event.relatedTarget||!drop.contains(event.relatedTarget)))drop.classList.remove('is-dragging');
  });
  document.addEventListener('drop',event=>{
    const drop=event.target.closest?.('[data-j-resume-drop]');
    if(!drop)return;
    event.preventDefault();drop.classList.remove('is-dragging');
    const file=event.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];if(file)importFile(file);
  });
  document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id==='j-intent-form'){event.preventDefault();saveIntent();}if(event.target.id==='j-preferences-form'){event.preventDefault();savePreferences();}if(event.target.id==='j-profile-editor')event.preventDefault();});
  function saveIntent(){dispatch({type:'SAVE_INTENT',goal:$('#j-goal').value,deadline:$('#j-deadline').value,hoursPerWeek:Number($('#j-hours').value),today:today()});}
  function savePreferences(){
    dispatch({type:'SAVE_CAREER_PREFERENCES',goals:$('#j-preference-goals')?.value||'',deadline:$('#j-preference-deadline')?.value||'',hoursPerWeek:$('#j-preference-hours')?.value||'',today:today()});
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    if(timeControl(event))return;
    if(!event.target.closest('.fd-search-wrap'))closeSearch();const target=event.target.closest('[data-j-action]');
    if(!target){
      const card=event.target.closest('[data-j-card]');
      if(card&&!event.target.closest('button,a,input,label,select,textarea,summary,details,[contenteditable]')&&!window.getSelection?.()?.toString())openDashboardSection(card.dataset.jCard);
      return;
    }
    if(target.disabled)return;const action=target.dataset.jAction;
    closeSearch();
    if(action==='OPEN_EXAMINER_EDITOR'){
      if(recording||voicePending){voiceError='请先结束录音，再调整面试官装扮。';render();return;}
      examiner?.stop();
    }
    if(globalThis.CareerJourneyInterviewer?.handleAction?.(action,target))return;
    if(action==='DAILY_CHECK_IN'){checkIn();return;}
    if(action==='SHOW_LEARNING_RECORDS'||action==='SHOW_RESUME_COMPARE'){dispatch({type:action});return;}
    if(action==='OPEN_DASHBOARD_SECTION'){openDashboardSection(target.dataset.section);return;}
    if(action==='OPEN_UPLOAD_PICKER'){const input=$('#journey-file');if(input&&!input.disabled)input.click?.();return;}
    if(action==='CLEAR_DASHBOARD_NOTICE'){dashboardNotice=null;render();$('#journey-app')?.focus?.({preventScroll:true});return;}
    if(action==='OVERVIEW_MODE'){overviewMode=['all','A','B'].includes(target.dataset.value)?target.dataset.value:'all';render();return;}
    if(action==='OVERVIEW_SLIDE'){overviewSlide=(overviewSlide+Number(target.dataset.value)+3)%3;render();return;}
    if(action==='OPEN_GUIDE'||action==='CLOSE_GUIDE'){guide=action==='OPEN_GUIDE';about=false;render();return;}
    if(action==='RESUME_TRAINING'){if(state.roleId)dispatch({type:M.trainingDone(state)?'OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER':state.branch==='B'&&!state.planAcknowledged?'SHOW_PLAN':'START_LEARNING'});return;}
    if(action==='START_LEARNING'&&M.trainingDone(state)){dispatch({type:'OPEN_PRACTICE_CENTER'});return;}
    if(action==='OPEN_KNOWLEDGE'){dispatch({type:'OPEN_LESSON',index:Number(target.dataset.index)});if(state.screen==='learn'){reviewingKnowledge=true;studyPage=0;render();}return;}
    if(action==='VIEW_REPORT'){dispatch({type:action,reportId:target.dataset.reportId});return;}
    if(action==='CONTINUE_PREPARATION'){
      const next=!state.profile?'SHOW_HOME':!state.confirmed?'SHOW_RESUME':!state.roleId?'GO_PATHS':state.branch==='B'&&!state.planAcknowledged?'SHOW_PLAN':!M.trainingDone(state)?'START_LEARNING':state.interview.finished?'BACK_FINISH':'START_INTERVIEW';dispatch({type:next});return;
    }
    if(action==='GREET'){Motion?.onAction?.('BUDDY_GREET',{xp:0,previousXp:0});return;}
    if(action==='ABOUT'||action==='CLOSE_ABOUT'){about=action==='ABOUT';guide=false;render();return;}
    if(action==='DOWNLOAD_PREPARED'||action==='DOWNLOAD_PREPARED_PDF'){const sample=D.sampleResume||D.profile,profile=R.importPrepared(sample.sourceText);download('体验简历-'+profile.name+'.pdf',R.toPDF(profile),'application/pdf');return;}
    if(action==='EXPORT_PDF'||action==='EXPORT_HTML'){if(state.profile){const polished=target.dataset.resumeVariant==='polished'?state.resumePolish?.draft:null;const p=polished||resumeDisplayProfile();download((p.name||'我的')+(polished||state.resumePolish&&state.resumeView==='polished'?'-优化简历.pdf':'-求职简历.pdf'),R.toPDF(p),'application/pdf');}return;}
    if(action==='EDIT_RESUME'||action==='CANCEL_EDIT'){editing=action==='EDIT_RESUME'?!editing:false;render();return;}
    if(action==='SAVE_PROFILE'){const profile=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(resumeDisplayProfile()));for(const node of document.querySelectorAll('[data-profile-field]')){const path=node.dataset.profileField.split('.');let parent=profile;for(const key of path.slice(0,-1))parent=parent[key];parent[path.at(-1)]=['skills','bullets','details'].includes(path.at(-1))?node.value.split(/\r?\n/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean):node.value.trim();}editing=false;dispatch({type:state.resumePolish&&state.resumeView==='polished'?'EDIT_POLISHED_RESUME':'EDIT_PROFILE',profile});return;}
    if(action==='APPLY_AND_CONFIRM_RESUME'){editing=false;dispatch({type:'APPLY_POLISHED_RESUME'});dispatch({type:'CONFIRM_RESUME'});return;}
    if(['OPTIMIZE_RESUME','SHOW_ORIGINAL_RESUME','SHOW_POLISHED_RESUME','RESTORE_ORIGINAL_RESUME'].includes(action)){editing=false;dispatch({type:action});return;}
    if(action==='SAVE_CAREER_PREFERENCES'){savePreferences();return;}
    if(action==='START_INTENDED_ROLE'){const selected=M.roleFor(target.dataset.roleId),p=state.careerPreferences;if(selected&&p)dispatch({type:'SAVE_INTENT',goal:selected.title,deadline:p.deadline,hoursPerWeek:p.hoursPerWeek,today:p.today});return;}
    if(action==='SAVE_INTENT'){saveIntent();return;}
    if(action==='DOWNLOAD_PLAN'){const value=M.planFor(state);const rows=[['周次','开始日期','结束日期','任务','交付成果','复盘重点','安排小时'],...value.calendar.map(week=>[week.week,addDays(state.intent.today,week.startDay-1),addDays(state.intent.today,week.endDay-1),week.task,week.deliverable,week.review,week.estimatedHours])];download(role().title+'-学习计划.csv','\uFEFF'+rows.map(row=>row.map(v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')).join('\r\n'),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');return;}
    if(action==='CHOOSE_LESSON'){dispatch({type:'SET_LESSON_INPUT',value:target.dataset.value});return;}
    if(['PM_BUILD','PM_RUN_CASE','PM_USE_PROMPT_EXAMPLE','PM_EDIT'].includes(action)){dispatch({type:action,caseId:target.dataset.caseId});return;}
    if(action==='CHECK_LESSON'&&lessons()[state.lessonIndex].kind==='metric')state=M.reduce(state,{type:'SET_LESSON_INPUT',value:$('#j-metric').value});
    if(action==='FINISH_TASK'){dispatch({type:'COMPLETE_LESSON'});dispatch({type:'NEXT_LESSON'});return;}
    if(action==='ANSWER_MODE'){if(recording||voicePending){voiceError='请先结束录音，再切换回答方式。';render();return;}voiceError='';draft=$('#j-answer')?.value||draft;answerMode=target.dataset.mode==='voice'?'voice':'text';render();return;}
    if(action==='START_VOICE'){startVoice();return;}
    if(action==='STOP_VOICE'){draft=$('#j-answer')?.value||draft;if(recorder?.state==='recording')recorder.stop();return;}
    if(['SPEAK_QUESTION','EXAMINER_CLARIFY','EXAMINER_HINT','STOP_EXAMINER','TOGGLE_EXAMINER_AUDIO','SPEAK_FEEDBACK'].includes(action)){
      if(recording||voicePending){voiceError='请先结束录音，再让面试官说话。';render();return;}
      if(action==='STOP_EXAMINER')examiner?.stop();
      else if(action==='TOGGLE_EXAMINER_AUDIO')examiner?.toggle();
      else if(action==='EXAMINER_CLARIFY')examiner?.clarify(currentRound());
      else if(action==='EXAMINER_HINT')examiner?.hint(currentRound());
      else if(action==='SPEAK_FEEDBACK')examiner?.speak(currentRound().feedback.improve);
      else examiner?.question(currentRound(),{greet:!examiner.snapshot().engaged});
      return;
    }
    if(action==='STUDY_NEXT'||action==='STUDY_PREV'){studyPage=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,studyPage+(action==='STUDY_NEXT'?1:-1)));render();return;}
    if(action==='REVIEW_KNOWLEDGE'){reviewingKnowledge=true;studyPage=0;render();return;}
    if(action==='START_PRACTICE'){reviewingKnowledge=false;dispatch({type:completed().includes(lessons()[state.lessonIndex]?.id)?'RESTART_LESSON':'START_PRACTICE',index:state.lessonIndex});return;}
    if(action==='START_INTERVIEW'&&state.interview.finished){dispatch({type:'OPEN_INTERVIEW_PRACTICE'});return;}
    if(action==='START_NEW_INTERVIEW'||action==='START_INTERVIEW'||action==='SKIP_TRAINING'||action==='OPEN_ONBOARDING_STEP'&&Number(target.dataset.index)===5){dispatch({type:action,index:5});if(state.screen==='interview')examiner?.question(currentRound(),{greet:action==='START_NEW_INTERVIEW'||!examiner.snapshot().engaged});return;}
    if(action==='NEXT_QUESTION'){dispatch({type:action});if(state.screen==='interview')examiner?.question(currentRound());else if(state.screen==='finish')examiner?.speak('这一轮面试完成了。你的学习计划、打卡记录和面试复盘已经整理到首页看板，我们继续加油。');return;}
    if(action==='SUBMIT_ANSWER'){const clip=clips.get(currentRound().id),text=$('#j-answer').value;dispatch({type:'SUBMIT_ANSWER',text:text.trim()?text:answerMode==='voice'&&clip?'语音回答 · '+clip.seconds+'秒':'',mode:answerMode});if(state.screen==='feedback')examiner?.acknowledge(state.interview.answers[state.interview.index],{final:state.interview.index===5});return;}
    if(action==='DOWNLOAD_REPORT_HTML'){const p=shownReport();download(p.profile.name+'-'+M.roleFor(p.roleId).title+'-第'+(p.interview.attemptNumber||1)+'次-求职准备报告.html',reportHTML(),'text/html;charset=utf-8');return;}
    if(action==='DOWNLOAD_REPORT'){const p=shownReport();download(p.profile.name+'-'+M.roleFor(p.roleId).title+'-第'+(p.interview.attemptNumber||1)+'次-准备记录.txt',M.reportText(state));return;}
    if(action==='RESET'){importGeneration++;importing=false;releaseVoice();editing=false;uploadError='';guide=false;about=false;overviewMode='all';overviewSlide=0;}
    dispatch({type:action,roleId:target.dataset.roleId,index:Number(target.dataset.index),textSize:target.dataset.jTextSize});
  });
  window.addEventListener?.('pagehide',()=>{releaseVoice();examiner?.stop();});
  render();
  recoverPortrait();
})();
